description: Finds and extracts facts from web pages and search results: dates, prices, availability, opening hours, published figures.
Reads and extracts facts from documents, PDFs, tickets and records: order details, ids, clauses, specifications.
Locates and explains relevant code: functions, call sites, configuration, tests, repository conventions.
Checks a proposed action against company policy and user constraints: refund windows, cancellation rules, budget limits, prohibited channels.
Reviews a code change against tests, style rules and production-safety requirements before it is applied.
Cross-checks claims against the evidence gathered: dates, quantities, names; flags unverified assumptions.
Drafts and prepares bookings, reservations, rebookings and schedule changes with exact dates, times and ids.
Drafts refunds, credits, plan changes and customer messages with exact amounts and order ids.
Drafts code changes: patches, new functions, configuration edits, following the repository's conventions.
Drafts the final answer or report with exact figures, dates and sources, stating what remains unverified.
Builds day-by-day itineraries and time plans that respect time windows, budgets and preferences.
Translates documents and messages between languages.
